## Functional Specification

Domain: emulator
Summary: A CHIP-8 emulator that accurately executes CHIP-8 ROMs with proper timing, input handling, and display output

### Requirements (MUST implement)
- Must implement all 35 CHIP-8 opcodes with cycle-accurate behavior
- Must provide 64x32 monochrome display with sprite drawing
- Must handle 16-key hexadecimal keypad input
- Must generate sound when sound timer is active
- Must load ROM files up to 3584 bytes (0xE00-0xFFF reserved)
- Must run at approximately 500-1000 Hz CPU frequency
- Must decrement timers at 60 Hz
- Must properly handle collision detection in sprite drawing

### Data Structures
- 16 8-bit registers V0-VF (V0-V7 general purpose, VF carry/flag)
- 4096 bytes RAM (0x000-0x1FF reserved for interpreter, 0x050-0x0A0 font, 0x200-0xFFF program)
- 16-bit index register I
- 16-bit program counter PC
- 8-bit delay timer
- 8-bit sound timer
- 16-level stack storing 16-bit addresses
- 8-bit stack pointer
- 64x32 pixel framebuffer (1-bit per pixel)
- 16-key keypad state (0-9, A-F)
- 16-byte input buffer for key press/release events

### Components
- **cpu** (complex, ~400 LOC)
  - fetch(): read 2 bytes from memory at PC, increment PC by 2
  - execute(opcode: number): decode and execute specific opcode
  - step(): fetch and execute one instruction
  - reset(): initialize all registers to default values
  - getRegister(index: number): get V register value
  - setRegister(index: number, value: number): set V register value
  - getPC(): get program counter
  - setPC(address: number): set program counter
  - getI(): get index register
  - setI(value: number): set index register
  - REQ: Implement all 35 CHIP-8 opcodes with proper behavior
  - REQ: Maintain 16 general purpose registers V0-VF
  - REQ: Manage program counter, index register, and stack
  - REQ: Handle timer decrement at 60Hz
  - REQ: Fetch and execute instructions at configurable speed
- **memory** (simple, ~50 LOC)
  - read(address: number): number: read byte at address
  - write(address: number, value: number): write byte at address
  - loadROM(data: Uint8Array): load ROM starting at 0x200
  - reset(): clear all memory and load font set
  - REQ: Provide 4096 bytes of addressable memory
  - REQ: Store 80-byte font set at 0x000-0x04F
  - REQ: Block writes to reserved interpreter memory 0x000-0x1FF
  - REQ: Load ROM data starting at 0x200
- **display** (medium, ~100 LOC)
  - drawSprite(x: number, y: number, sprite: Uint8Array): boolean: draw sprite, return collision
  - clear(): clear entire display
  - getPixel(x: number, y: number): boolean: get pixel state
  - setPixel(x: number, y: number, value: boolean): set pixel state
  - getFramebuffer(): Uint8Array(256) get raw framebuffer data
  - REQ: Provide 64x32 pixel monochrome display
  - REQ: Draw 8-pixel wide sprites of variable height
  - REQ: Handle sprite wrapping at screen edges
  - REQ: Track pixel collision for VF register
  - REQ: Provide clear screen functionality
- **input** (simple, ~60 LOC)
  - isKeyPressed(key: number): boolean: check if key is pressed
  - waitKey(): Promise<number>: wait for any key press and return key
  - pressKey(key: number): mark key as pressed
  - releaseKey(key: number): mark key as released
  - reset(): release all keys
  - REQ: Track state of 16 CHIP-8 keys (0-9, A-F)
  - REQ: Provide blocking wait for key press
  - REQ: Map system keyboard to CHIP-8 layout
- **sound** (simple, ~30 LOC)
  - play(): start sound output
  - stop(): stop sound output
  - setFrequency(hz: number): set tone frequency
  - REQ: Generate square wave tone when sound timer > 0
  - REQ: Stop sound when sound timer reaches 0
- **timer** (simple, ~40 LOC)
  - start(): start timer loop
  - stop(): stop timer loop
  - update(): decrement timers if > 0
  - REQ: Decrement delay and sound timers at 60Hz
  - REQ: Notify CPU of timer updates
  - REQ: Maintain accurate 60Hz timing

### Integration Rules (CRITICAL)
- CPU must read/write memory exclusively through memory.read() and memory.write()
- CPU must draw sprites exclusively through display.drawSprite()
- CPU must check input exclusively through input.isKeyPressed() and input.waitKey()
- CPU must trigger sound exclusively through sound.play() and sound.stop()
- No component may directly access another component's internal state
- cpu MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- timer MUST use injected dependencies via their interfaces. Do NOT duplicate state that other modules own.
- Each component owns its own state. Other components access it ONLY through the public interface — never copy internal data.
- Use camelCase for all method names. No snake_case.

### Acceptance Criteria
- Can load and execute IBM logo ROM showing proper logo
- Can run Pong game with working input controls
- Can run Space Invaders with proper collision detection
- All 35 opcodes pass test suite verification
- Sound buzzes when sound timer > 0
- Display shows proper sprite rendering with wrapping
- Input correctly maps to CHIP-8 keypad layout
